newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Chlor-Alkali intl net down 1.41 pct.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Chlor-Alkali intl net down 1.41 pct.

text.p: Shanghai Chlor-Alkali Chemical Co Ltd's 1996 net profit fell 1.41 percent under international accounting standards due to poor market conditions, a company statement said on Thursday.
The company reaped 234.775 million yuan in net profit for 1996 compared with 231.501 million yuan for 1995 based on international standards, the statement in the Shanghai Securities News said.

"The situation of the chlor alkali chemical industry has worsened," it said. "On one hand, prices for raw materials rose and on the other hand, the sales prices for the company's products fell sharply due to competition from foreign firms."

The company managed to keep profits close to the previous year's through increased production of high-value products and lower costs achieved by reducing energy consumption and management expenses, the statement said.
Based on Chinese accounting standards, the company's 1996 net profit was 234.462 million yuan, up 2.14 percent from 1995's 229.559 million yuan, it said.
The company's board of directors proposed a one-for-ten bonus issue and a cash dividend of 0.06 yuan per share, pending approval of a shareholders meeting, it added.
